Microsoft Visual C++ runtime redistributables (desktop x64)

Copyright Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.

This package includes Microsoft-signed msvcp140.dll, vcruntime140.dll and
vcruntime140_1.dll from the installed Visual Studio C++ redistributable set.
These components retain their Microsoft copyright and license terms; the
Todorbit project license does not replace those terms.

Microsoft's Visual Studio 2022 redistribution guidance and redistributable list:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/releases/2022/redistribution

Exact deployed versions and SHA-256 values: data/windows-crt.json.
